It is one of the {{ill|Sengen shrine|fa|زیارتگاه سنگن|fr|Sanctuaires Asama|it|Santuario di Asama|ja|浅間神社|sv|Asama-helgedom|zh|淺間神社|qid=Q3471785|lt=Asama shrines}} and holds historical Rank as a {{ill|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|lt=Shikinaisha}} ({{ill|Myōjin Taisha|ja|名神大社|fr|Myōjin Taisha|zh|名神大社}}) {{ill|Ronsha|ja|論社|1=candidate shrines|2=ja|3=論社|lt=candidate|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ronsha|13=User:Immanuelle/candidate shrines|1=Engishiki_Jinmyōchō#Ronsha|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki_Jinmyocho|lt=Ronsha}}}}, with its Rank under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|en|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=Modern system of Ranked Shinto shrines}} being a {{ill|Ken-sha|lt=Modern system of Ranked Shinto shrines|lt=Prefectural shrine|ja|県社|qid=Q90139226}}{{efn|Ken-sha|qid=Q90139226|lt=Ken-sha|1=modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/village shrine|qq=ja_comment|qid=Q90139226|qq= 近代社格制度}}. The shrine is part of the World Cultural Heritage designation as a component of "Mount Fuji - Object of Worship and Source of Artistic Inspiration."

== deity ==
The enshrined deity is:
* {{ill|Konohanasakuya-hime|ja|木花咲耶姫命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Konohanasakuya-hime|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to QID FIXED|qid=Q1781862}}, referred to as {{ill|Sengen shrine|fa|زیارتگاه سنگن|fr|Sanctuaires Asama|it|Santuario di Asama|ja|浅間神社|sv|Asama-helgedom|zh|淺間神社|qid=Q3471785}} by the shrine. According to the shrine's records, her husband, {{ill|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|ja|邇邇芸命|lt=Ninigi}}, and her father, {{ill|Ōyamatsumi|abstract|Q386563|az|Ooyamatsimu|de|Ōyamatsumi|fa|اویاماتسومی|fr|Ōyamatsumi|hr|O-Yama-Tsu-mi|ja|オオヤマツミ|ko|오야마쓰미노카미|mni|ꯑꯣꯌꯃꯠꯁꯨꯃꯤ|ru|Ооямацуми|simple|Ōyamatsumi|sv|Ōyamatsumi|tr|Ōyamatsumi|zh|大山津見|qid=Q386563}}, are also worshipped in the same hall.

== History ==
=== Foundation ===
The shrine was established in 865 (Jōgan 7) to quell the eruption of Mount Fuji that began in 864. The eruption caused extensive damage, which was believed to result from neglect of worship at {{ill|Sengen shrine|fa|زیارتگاه سنگن|fr|Sanctuaires Asama|it|Santuario di Asama|ja|浅間神社|sv|Asama-helgedom|zh|淺間神社|qid=Q3471785|lt=Sengen Shrine}} in {{ill|Suruga Province|ckb|پارێزگای سروگا|cs|Provincie Suruga|de|Provinz Suruga|eo|Provinco Suruga|es|Provincia de Suruga|fa|ولایت سوروگا|fr|Province de Suruga|gl|Provincia de Suruga|hak|Suruga-koet|id|Provinsi Suruga|it|Suruga (provincia)|ja|駿河国|ko|스루가국|lt|Surugos žemė|nl|Suruga (provincie)|pt|Província de Suruga|ru|Суруга (провинция)|simple|Suruga Province|sk|Suruga (provincia)|sr|Провинција Суруга|th|แคว้นซูรูงะ|tr|Suruga (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Суруґа|vi|Tỉnh Suruga|zh|駿河國|zh_min_nan|Suruga-kok|zh_yue|駿河國|qid=Q864170|lt=Suruga Province}}. Consequently, it was decided to enshrine Asama Ōkami in {{ill|Kai Province|en|Kai Province|qid=Q858076|lt=Kai Province}}. The shrine is listed as a {{ill|Myōjin Taisha|ja|名神大社|fr|Myōjin Taisha|zh|名神大社}} in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳}}.

The shrine's role as a {{ill|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|lt=Shikinaisha}} has been debated, with {{ill|Ichinomiya Asama Shrine (Fuefuki)|en|Ichinomiya Asama Shrine (Fuefuki)|qid=Q11557476|lt=Fuefuki City Asama Shrine}} in Fuefuki City being another possible site.

=== Development ===
The surrounding area developed as a hub for Mount Fuji worship but declined with the rise of {{ill|Fujiko (religion)|en|Fujiko (religion)|qid=Q11456201|lt=Fujikō}} pilgrimages in the Edo period. In 1871 (Meiji 4), the shrine was Ranked as a {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|qid=Q134917316}}{{efn|District Shrines|qid=Q90139226|lt=Ken-sha|1=modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/village shrine|qq=ja_comment|qid=Q134917316|qq= 近代社格制度}}, later promoted to a {{ill|Ken-sha|lt=Modern system of Ranked Shinto shrines|lt=Prefectural shrine|ja|県社|qid=Q90139226}}{{efn|Ken-sha|qid=Q90139226|lt=Ken-sha|1=modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/village shrine|qq=ja_comment|qid=Q90139226|qq= 近代社格制度}} in 1924 (Taishō 13).

== Cultural Properties ==
=== National Historic Site ===
* Part of the "Mount Fuji" Historic Site designation.

=== Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property ===
* {{ill|Kawaguchi no Chigomai|ja|河口の稚児舞|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chigo no Mai of Kawaguchi|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11553660}}, designated in 2017.

=== Yamanashi Prefectural Natural Monuments ===
* The "Seven Sacred Cedars" at the shrine are over 1,200 years old.

== Access ==
* Bus: From Kawaguchiko Station (Fujikyuko Line), take a bus bound for Kōfu or Ōishi and get off at "Kawaguchi Post Office." The shrine is a short walk north.
